# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'elasticsearch'
require 'jwt'
require 'redis'

# Search Indexing Service - Kubernetes deployment
# Handles document indexing and search across tenant namespaces

module SearchService
  class TenantResolver
    NAMESPACE_HEADER = 'X-K8s-Namespace'

    def initialize(redis_client)
      @redis = redis_client
      @namespace_cache = {}
    end

    def resolve_tenant(request)
      token = extract_token(request)
      claims = decode_token(token)
      tenant_id = claims['tenant_id']
      namespace = claims['namespace'] || derive_namespace(tenant_id)

      TenantContext.new(
        tenant_id: tenant_id,
        namespace: namespace,
        roles: claims['roles'] || [],
        index_prefix: build_index_prefix(namespace, tenant_id)
      )
    end

    private

    def extract_token(request)
      auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] || ''
      auth_header.sub(/^Bearer\s+/, '')
    end

    def decode_token(token)
      # Fail closed: never fall back to a hardcoded secret. If JWT_SECRET is
      # not configured the service must not accept any token.
      secret = ENV['JWT_SECRET']
      if secret.nil? || secret.strip.empty?
        halt 500, { error: 'Server misconfiguration' }.to_json
      end
      JWT.decode(token, secret, true, algorithm: 'HS256')[0]
    rescue JWT::DecodeError => e
      halt 401, { error: 'Invalid token' }.to_json
    end

    def derive_namespace(tenant_id)
      "tenant-#{tenant_id}"
    end

    def build_index_prefix(namespace, tenant_id)
      "#{namespace}_#{tenant_id}"
    end
  end

  TenantContext = Struct.new(:tenant_id, :namespace, :roles, :index_prefix, keyword_init: true)

  class IndexAccessControl
    def initialize(redis_client)
      @redis = redis_client
    end

    # Validates that the requested index belongs to the tenant's namespace
    def authorize_index_access(tenant_ctx, requested_index)
      return true if tenant_ctx.roles.include?('cluster-admin')

      # Check if the index is within the tenant's allowed prefix
      allowed_prefix = tenant_ctx.index_prefix
      normalize_and_check(allowed_prefix, requested_index)
    end

    private

    def normalize_and_check(allowed_prefix, requested_index)
      # Normalize index name: strip leading/trailing whitespace, downcase
      normalized_index = requested_index.strip.downcase
      normalized_prefix = allowed_prefix.strip.downcase

      # Security check: index must start with the tenant's prefix
      # and must either equal the prefix or have a separator after it
      return false unless normalized_index.start_with?(normalized_prefix)

      # Ensure exact prefix match (not just substring)
      remainder = normalized_index[normalized_prefix.length..]
      remainder.nil? || remainder.empty? || remainder.start_with?('_', '-', '/')
    end
  end

  class SearchApp < Sinatra::Base
    set :show_exceptions, false

    configure do
      set :es_client, Elasticsearch::Client.new(
        url: ENV['ELASTICSEARCH_URL'] || 'http://elasticsearch:9200'
      )
      set :redis_client, Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://redis:6379')
      set :tenant_resolver, TenantResolver.new(settings.redis_client)
      set :access_control, IndexAccessControl.new(settings.redis_client)
    end

    before do
      content_type :json
      @tenant = settings.tenant_resolver.resolve_tenant(request)
    end

    # Search documents within an index
    post '/api/v1/search' do
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      target_index = payload['index']
      query = payload['query']

      halt 400, { error: 'Missing index parameter' }.to_json unless target_index
      halt 400, { error: 'Missing query parameter' }.to_json unless query
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid query parameter' }.to_json unless query.is_a?(String)

      # Reject wildcard and multi-index patterns
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid index name' }.to_json if target_index.match?(/[*,]/) 

      # Authorize access to the requested index
      unless settings.access_control.authorize_index_access(@tenant, target_index)
        halt 403, { error: 'Access denied to index' }.to_json
      end

      results = perform_search(target_index, query)
      { results: results, tenant: @tenant.tenant_id, index: target_index }.to_json
    end

    # Bulk index documents
    post '/api/v1/index' do
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      target_index = payload['index']
      documents = payload['documents']

      halt 400, { error: 'Missing index parameter' }.to_json unless target_index
      halt 400, { error: 'Missing documents parameter' }.to_json unless documents

      # Reject wildcard and multi-index patterns
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid index name' }.to_json if target_index.match?(/[*,]/)

      unless settings.access_control.authorize_index_access(@tenant, target_index)
        halt 403, { error: 'Access denied to index' }.to_json
      end

      indexed = bulk_index(target_index, documents)
      { indexed: indexed, tenant: @tenant.tenant_id }.to_json
    end

    # Get document by ID from a specific index
    get '/api/v1/documents/:index/:doc_id' do
      target_index = params[:index]
      doc_id = params[:doc_id]

      # Reject wildcard and multi-index patterns
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid index name' }.to_json if target_index.match?(/[*,]/)

      unless settings.access_control.authorize_index_access(@tenant, target_index)
        halt 403, { error: 'Access denied to index' }.to_json
      end

      doc = fetch_document(target_index, doc_id)
      halt 404, { error: 'Document not found' }.to_json unless doc
      { document: doc, tenant: @tenant.tenant_id }.to_json
    end

    # Cross-index search - searches across multiple indices owned by tenant
    post '/api/v1/search/multi' do
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      indices = payload['indices'] || []
      query = payload['query']

      halt 400, { error: 'Missing query parameter' }.to_json unless query
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid query parameter' }.to_json unless query.is_a?(String)
      halt 400, { error: 'Too many indices' }.to_json if indices.length > 10

      # Reject any index with wildcard or comma patterns
      indices.each do |idx|
        halt 400, { error: 'Invalid index name' }.to_json if idx.match?(/[*,]/)
      end

      # Authorize each index individually - reject entire request if any unauthorized
      indices.each do |idx|
        unless settings.access_control.authorize_index_access(@tenant, idx)
          halt 403, { error: "Access denied to index: #{idx}" }.to_json
        end
      end

      results = perform_search(indices.join(','), query) unless indices.empty?
      { results: results || [], authorized_count: indices.length }.to_json
    end

    private

    def perform_search(index, query)
      settings.es_client.search(
        index: index,
        body: { query: { query_string: { query: query } } }
      )['hits']['hits']
    rescue => e
      halt 500, { error: 'Search failed' }.to_json
    end

    def bulk_index(index, documents)
      body = documents.flat_map do |doc|
        [{ index: { _index: index } }, doc]
      end
      settings.es_client.bulk(body: body)
    rescue => e
      halt 500, { error: 'Indexing failed' }.to_json
    end

    def fetch_document(index, doc_id)
      settings.es_client.get(index: index, id: doc_id)['_source']
    rescue Elasticsearch::Transport::Transport::Errors::NotFound
      nil
    rescue => e
      halt 500, { error: 'Fetch failed' }.to_json
    end
  end
end
